title: What happens if the dropped ball rolls out of the relief area?
question: After you drop your ball in the correct place, it rolls out of the relief area. What do you do next?

choices.text: Drop the ball again in the relief area
Place the ball where it stopped
Hit it from where it finished
Move it back to the original spot

explanation: If your dropped ball comes to rest outside the relief area, you must drop it again within the relief area.
imagePrompt: A teenage golfer watches as a dropped ball rolls out of a clearly marked relief area on the fairway.
imageAlt: Golf ball rolling out of a marked relief area after a drop.
